_comment: Reuse map: archetype rig -> the SRD stat blocks it embodies. Source of truth for resources/monsters/visuals/bindings.json — regenerate with `python tools/creature_forge/gen_bindings.py` (never hand-edit the output). Per-member overrides: tint [r,g,b] multiplies the rig's box colors (the ONLY recolor lever that reaches creature_forge rigs, whose boxes carry explicit colors), scale -> appearance heightScale+bulkScale, alpha < 1 for incorporeals, plus animationMapping/faction/appearance passthrough. `approx` names the archetype a later wave should move this member to — coverage is complete now, fidelity improves per wave.
